terms.definition: A canonical support-state digest identifies which managed support surfaces changed across platforms; it does not determine the semantic meaning, correctness, or required repair set of those changes.
A relationship detected from code, support changes, or tooling remains non-authoritative evidence until the target decision owner accepts it into the owning registry or consistency graph.

Start from changed paths or fact IDs, select matching graph shards, and traverse only accepted relationships within target-owned limits before reasoning over the resulting concrete surfaces and residual gaps.
terms.scope: large-project change impact and context economy
non_meanings: unmapped paths are safe to ignore
